metadata.question: Did Lac Rouge shrink by more than 90% between June 21, 2024 and June 15, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Target dates: 2024-06-21 and 2025-06-15. Use ±21-day windows around each date.
- Primary collection: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED), filtered to AOI and time window, choose least-cloudy image.
- Fallback collection: Landsat 8/9 L2 (LANDSAT/LC08/09/C02/T1_L2), combined, choose least-cloudy image.
- AOI: Point assumed for Lac Rouge near Rivière-Rouge, Quebec (46.41, -74.87) buffered to 5 km.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds for S2 using QA60 bits 10 and 11.
- Mask clouds for Landsat L2 using QA_PIXEL bits (dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, shadow, snow).
- Compute NDWI; classify water as NDWI > 0.3.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection sizes first; if empty after fallback -> C1.
- Compute total vs valid pixel counts inside AOI; if valid==0 for a date -> C2.
- Compute water areas (km²); if any area is null/NaN or if baseline area<=0 (division by zero) -> C3.
- Otherwise compute shrink% = (A2024 - A2025)/A2024*100; A if >90%, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((res, rej) => obj.getInfo(res, rej));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lacRougePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.87, 46.41]); // Assumed Lac Rouge near Rivière-Rouge, QC
  const aoi = lacRougePoint.buffer(5000); // 5 km radius
  const dateA = '2024-06-21';
  const dateB = '2025-06-15';
  const winDays = 21;

  const scale = 1000; // per requirement
  const maxPixels = 1e9;

  function dateWindow(dateStr, days) {
    const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
    return [d.advance(-days, 'day'), d.advance(days, 'day')];
  }

  // Cloud masks and NDWI
  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0));
    return img.updateMask(cloud.not());
  }

  function ndwiFrom(img, sensor) {
    if (sensor === 'S2') {
      const green = img.select('B3');
      const nir = img.select('B8');
      return green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI');
    } else {
      // Landsat 8/9 L2 scaled
      const green = img.select('SR_B3');
      const nir = img.select('SR_B5');
      return green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI');
    }
  }

  function scaleL8L9SR(img) {
    const optical = img.select(['SR_B.*']);
    const scaled = optical.multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }

  function maskL8L9(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow
      .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  async function getBestS2(dateStr) {
    const [start, end] = dateWindow(dateStr, winDays);
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
      .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) return { image: null, size: 0 };
    const img = col.first();
    const cloudMeta = await getInfo(img.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
    const id = await getInfo(img.get('PRODUCT_ID'));
    const date = await getInfo(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    return { image: img, size, cloudMeta, id, date, sensor: 'S2' };
  }

  async function getBestLandsat(dateStr) {
    const [start, end] = dateWindow(dateStr, winDays);
    let l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end);
    let l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(aoi).filterDate(start, end);
    let col = l8.merge(l9).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 80)).sort('CLOUD_COVER');
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) return { image: null, size: 0 };
    const img = col.first();
    const imgScaled = scaleL8L9SR(img);
    const cloudMeta = await getInfo(img.get('CLOUD_COVER'));
    const id = await getInfo(img.get('LANDSAT_PRODUCT_ID'));
    const date = await getInfo(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
    return { image: imgScaled, size, cloudMeta, id, date, sensor: 'L8L9' };
  }

  async function prepareImage(record) {
    if (!record.image) return null;
    if (record.sensor === 'S2') {
      return maskS2(record.image).select(['B2','B3','B4','B8','QA60'], ['B2','B3','B4','B8','QA60']);
    } else {
      return maskL8L9(record.image).select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','QA_PIXEL'], ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','QA_PIXEL']);
    }
  }

  async function metrics(record) {
    const imgMasked = await prepareImage(record);
    if (!imgMasked) return null;

    let bandForCount = record.sensor === 'S2' ? 'B3' : 'SR_B3';

    // Total pixels (before cloud mask): use unmasked original image band
    const original = record.image;
    const total = await getInfo(original.select(bandForCount).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get(bandForCount));

    // Valid pixels after masking
    const valid = await getInfo(imgMasked.select(bandForCount).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get(bandForCount));

    const totalCount = total || 0;
    const validCount = valid || 0;
    const cloudPct = (totalCount > 0) ? (100 * (1 - (validCount / totalCount))) : null;

    // NDWI and water area (km2)
    const ndwi = ndwiFrom(imgMasked, record.sensor);
    const water = ndwi.gt(0.3).selfMask();
    const areaKm2 = await getInfo(ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).divide(1e6).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: aoi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('area'));

    const waterKm2 = areaKm2 === null ? null : areaKm2;

    return { totalCount, validCount, cloudPct, waterKm2 };
  }

  try {
    console.log(`AOI center: 46.41,-74.87 (radius: 5km)`);

    // Acquire for A (2024)
    let recA = await getBestS2(dateA);
    if (!recA.image) recA = await getBestLandsat(dateA);
    if (!recA.image) {
      console.log(`2024 window images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    } else {
      console.log(`2024 window images: ${recA.size} | Chosen: ${recA.sensor} ${recA.id} (${recA.date}) CloudMeta: ${recA.cloudMeta}`);
    }

    // Acquire for B (2025)
    let recB = await getBestS2(dateB);
    if (!recB.image) recB = await getBestLandsat(dateB);
    if (!recB.image) {
      console.log(`2025 window images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    } else {
      console.log(`2025 window images: ${recB.size} | Chosen: ${recB.sensor} ${recB.id} (${recB.date}) CloudMeta: ${recB.cloudMeta}`);
    }

    // Metrics
    const mA = await metrics(recA);
    const mB = await metrics(recB);

    if (!mA || !mB) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`2024 Pixels (total/valid): ${mA.totalCount}/${mA.validCount} Cloud%: ${mA.cloudPct !== null ? mA.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`2025 Pixels (total/valid): ${mB.totalCount}/${mB.validCount} Cloud%: ${mB.cloudPct !== null ? mB.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);

    if (mA.totalCount === 0 || mB.totalCount === 0 || mA.validCount === 0 || mB.validCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Validate areas
    if (mA.waterKm2 === null || mB.waterKm2 === null || isNaN(mA.waterKm2) || isNaN(mB.waterKm2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Water km2 2024: ${mA.waterKm2.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Water km2 2025: ${mB.waterKm2.toFixed(3)}`);

    if (mA.waterKm2 <= 0) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const shrinkPct = ((mA.waterKm2 - mB.waterKm2) / mA.waterKm2) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Shrink%: ${shrinkPct.toFixed(2)}`);

    if (isNaN(shrinkPct) || !isFinite(shrinkPct)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Final Answer
    if (shrinkPct > 90) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error:', e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
